sloka: ततो मातलिपुत्रे तु गोमुखे राक्षसात्मजः ।सारथौ पातयामास शरान्कनकभूषणान् ।। ७.२८.१० ॥
transliteration: tato mātaliputre tu gomukhe rākṣasātmajaḥ ।sārathau pātayāmāsa śarānkanakabhūṣaṇān ।। 7.28.10 ॥

translations.english: Then, the son of the Rakshasa (Meghanada) shot gold-embellished arrows at Matali's son, Gomukha, who was the charioteer.
